C08-M07-L03-F1.title: From tactic to detection: one Banyan chain through ATT&CK
C08-M07-L03-F1.caption: The ATT&CK hierarchy as a stack, from the Execution tactic down to the observed procedure on WS-104 and the rule that recognises it.
C08-M07-L03-F1.alt: Five stacked bands, most abstract at the top. Dark band: Tactic TA0002 Execution, the why: run malicious code. Violet band: Technique T1059, Command and Scripting Interpreter. Orange band: Sub-technique T1059.001, PowerShell. Red band: Procedure, Word macro starts hidden PowerShell on WS-104 at 06:14. Green band at the bottom: Detection, minisiem R1 or the Sigma rule, WINWORD.EXE parent plus powershell.exe child. Note: rules are written at the bottom and mapped upwards.
C08-M07-L03-F1.note: Rules are written at the procedure level and mapped upwards; tag only as high as the observation supports.

C08-M07-L03-F2.title: Banyan coverage matrix: data, rule, test
C08-M07-L03-F2.caption: Each technique in the Banyan storyline with the lab data that could show it, the rule that claims it, whether that rule has a test, and the status that combination deserves.
C08-M07-L03-F2.alt: Table with five columns: Technique, Data (lab), Rule, Tested, Status. Row 1, red: T1566 Phishing; proxy only, no mail logs; no rule; not applicable; gap: R1 sees next step. Row 2, green: T1204.002 Malicious File; Sysmon EID 1; R1; yes; covered. Row 3, blue: T1059 PowerShell / cmd; Sysmon EID 1; R1; yes, Word parent only; partial. Row 4, green: T1071.001 Web Protocols; proxy; R6; yes; covered. Row 5, green: T1110.003 Password Spraying; VPN; R2; yes; covered. Row 6, orange: T1136.001 Local Account; Security 4720; R3; no; untested. Row 7, orange: T1098 Account Manipulation; Security 4732; R3; no; untested. Row 8, orange: T1567 Exfil Over Web Service; proxy sizes; R4; no; untested. Row 9, orange: T1685.005 Clear Windows Event Logs; Security 1102; R5; no; untested. Note: status is the weakest of data, rule and test.
C08-M07-L03-F2.note: Status is the weakest of data, rule and test: an untested rule is not coverage.
